Seafood supply for menus that depend on consistency

Restaurants and hotels need seafood that performs the same way every service. We work with your chefs and purchase team to understand the cuts, counts and pack sizes your menu needs, then plan supply around your consumption.

  • Products held in our own cold storage with maintained temperature
  • Shelf life checked before dispatch — expired stock is never sent
  • Non-vegetarian products stored separately from vegetarian lines
  • One contact for seafood plus Japanese pantry, cheese and proteins
